payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear description of how hateful tweets aimed at women are detected and classified using the ParityBOT system, which employs a specific feature from the Perspective API to assess tweet toxicity.

claims.text: ParityBOT classifies hateful tweets directed at women in politics using the TOXICITY probability feature from the Perspective API, which is predictive of whether a tweet is hateful.
The system collects tweets in real-time and analyzes them to classify whether they are hateful or not, focusing on tweets mentioning specific women candidates.
ParityBOT aims to improve discourse by responding to hateful tweets with supportive messages, thereby encouraging women in politics.
